lifeEvents.title: Views the promised land from Mount Nebo
lifeEvents.description: Yahweh shows him all of it, and tells him he will not cross over.

lifeEvents.title: Dies in the land of Moab
lifeEvents.description: At a hundred twenty years old, his eye not dim nor his strength gone. No prophet like him has arisen in Israel since.

lifeEvents.title: Healed of leprosy in the Jordan
lifeEvents.description: Swallows his pride, washes seven times, and comes up clean — then declares Israel's God the only God.

lifeEvents.title: Refuses to sell his vineyard, and is killed for it
lifeEvents.description: Won't give up his family's inheritance to the king, and is falsely accused and stoned.

lifeEvents.title: Ordained a priest
lifeEvents.description: He is set apart alongside his father and brothers.

lifeEvents.title: Dies offering unauthorized fire
lifeEvents.description: He and his brother Abihu offer incense God never commanded, and are killed instantly.

lifeEvents.title: Leaves Bethlehem for Moab
lifeEvents.description: Famine drives her, her husband, and their two sons to Moabite country.

lifeEvents.title: Loses her husband and both sons
lifeEvents.description: Elimelech dies, then ten years later both her sons — leaving her with only her two daughters-in-law.

lifeEvents.title: Urges Ruth and Orpah to go home
lifeEvents.description: With nothing left to offer them, she tells her daughters-in-law to return to their mothers' houses and remarry.

lifeEvents.title: Returns to Bethlehem, calling herself Mara
lifeEvents.description: "I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again empty."

lifeEvents.title: Sends Ruth to Boaz's field, then to the threshing floor
lifeEvents.description: She recognises Boaz as a near kinsman and coaches Ruth on how to ask him for redemption.

lifeEvents.title: Nurses her grandson Obed
lifeEvents.description: The women of Bethlehem tell her a son has been born to her, and name him Obed.

lifeEvents.title: Delivers God's covenant to David
lifeEvents.description: Tells David that God will build him a house — a throne established forever.

lifeEvents.title: Confronts David with a parable
lifeEvents.description: Tells the story of the rich man and the poor man's lamb, then says, "You are the man."

lifeEvents.title: Is convinced Jesus is the Son of God
lifeEvents.description: Moves from skepticism to belief the moment Jesus reveals he already knew him.

lifeEvents.title: Has Daniel interpret his dream
lifeEvents.description: Promotes Daniel after his dream of a statue and a mountain-filling stone is revealed.

lifeEvents.title: Sees three men unharmed in the furnace
lifeEvents.description: Builds the furnace to punish defiance and blesses their God when they survive.

lifeEvents.title: Besieges and burns Jerusalem
lifeEvents.description: Destroys the temple and city and carries Judah into exile in Babylon.

lifeEvents.title: Is humbled by seven years of madness
lifeEvents.description: Boasts over Babylon and is struck with madness until he acknowledges the Most High.

lifeEvents.title: Weeps and prays on hearing Jerusalem's walls lie broken
lifeEvents.description: Fasts and prays for days after learning of Jerusalem's ruined state.

lifeEvents.title: Asks the king's leave and inspects the ruined walls by night
lifeEvents.description: Receives royal letters and provisions, then surveys the wall secretly before announcing his plan.

lifeEvents.title: Arms the builders against threats and presses on
lifeEvents.description: Sets a guard and arms the people by family as Sanballat's alliance threatens attack.

lifeEvents.title: Confronts the nobles over usury against the poor
lifeEvents.description: Demands the nobles return what they've taken from the poor and stop charging interest.

lifeEvents.title: Refuses Sanballat's trap; finishes the wall in 52 days
lifeEvents.description: Sees through repeated plots and completes the wall in fifty-two days.

lifeEvents.title: Tells the grieving people the day is holy, not for mourning
lifeEvents.description: Calms the weeping assembly with Ezra after the law is read, sending them to celebrate.

lifeEvents.title: Returns to purge the temple, restore the Levites, and enforce the Sabbath
lifeEvents.description: Cleans out Tobiah's room, restores Levite support, and enforces Sabbath and marriage law.

lifeEvents.title: Visits Jesus at night
lifeEvents.description: Comes to Jesus secretly and is taught about the new birth.

lifeEvents.title: Found righteous in a violent generation
lifeEvents.description: Noah walks with God while the earth is filled with violence.

lifeEvents.title: Builds the ark
lifeEvents.description: He does all that God commanded him — exactly.

lifeEvents.title: Rides out the flood
lifeEvents.description: Shut in by God, the family and the animals survive while the waters cover the earth.

lifeEvents.title: Given the rainbow
lifeEvents.description: God sets his bow in the cloud as the sign of a covenant with every living creature.

lifeEvents.title: Marries into Naomi's family, then is widowed
lifeEvents.description: She marries one of Naomi's sons and is left a widow with Ruth and Naomi.

lifeEvents.title: Returns to her own people
lifeEvents.description: She weeps and kisses Naomi goodbye, and goes back to Moab — a choice the text never condemns.

lifeEvents.title: Watches Stephen's stoning as a young persecutor
lifeEvents.description: Holds the coats of the witnesses while approving of Stephen's death.

lifeEvents.title: Is converted on the road to Damascus
lifeEvents.description: Is blinded by a vision of the risen Jesus and begins preaching the faith he once persecuted.

lifeEvents.title: Is set apart with Barnabas for missionary work
lifeEvents.description: Begins the first missionary journey and increasingly goes by his Roman name, Paul.

lifeEvents.title: Argues for Gentile freedom from the law at the Jerusalem council
lifeEvents.description: Disputes the circumcision requirement and is vindicated by the council's decision.

lifeEvents.title: Sings hymns in a Philippian jail and leads the jailer to faith
lifeEvents.description: Is freed by an earthquake and stops the jailer from killing himself.

lifeEvents.title: Preaches to the philosophers at the Areopagus
lifeEvents.description: Uses an altar to an unknown God as a bridge to proclaim the resurrection.

lifeEvents.title: Is nearly killed by a mob and arrested by Roman soldiers
lifeEvents.description: Is rescued from a lynching and promised by Jesus that he will testify in Rome.

lifeEvents.title: Survives a shipwreck on the way to Rome
lifeEvents.description: Is promised by an angel that no lives will be lost, and survives a viper bite unharmed.

lifeEvents.title: Preaches freely under house arrest in Rome
lifeEvents.description: Spends two years welcoming visitors and teaching about Jesus without hindrance.

lifeEvents.title: Is promised paradise by the crucified Jesus
lifeEvents.description: Rebukes the other criminal's mockery and asks to be remembered in Jesus's kingdom.

lifeEvents.title: Is brought to Jesus by his brother Andrew and renamed
lifeEvents.description: Is renamed Cephas/Peter the first time he meets Jesus.

lifeEvents.title: Falls at Jesus's feet after a miraculous catch of fish
lifeEvents.description: Calls himself a sinful man, then leaves everything to follow Jesus.

lifeEvents.title: Walks on water, then sinks in doubt
lifeEvents.description: Steps out onto the water toward Jesus, then begins to sink and is caught.

lifeEvents.title: Confesses Jesus as the Christ, then rebukes him
lifeEvents.description: Declares Jesus the Son of the living God, then objects to his prediction of suffering.

lifeEvents.title: Witnesses the Transfiguration
lifeEvents.description: Sees Jesus transfigured with Moses and Elijah and offers to build three shelters.

lifeEvents.title: Protests, then wants his hands and head washed too
lifeEvents.description: Objects to Jesus washing his feet, then overcorrects.

lifeEvents.title: Falls asleep instead of keeping watch with Jesus
lifeEvents.description: Is unable to stay awake through Jesus's prayer in Gethsemane.

lifeEvents.title: Denies knowing Jesus three times
lifeEvents.description: Denies Jesus in the high priest's courtyard, then weeps bitterly when the rooster crows.

lifeEvents.title: Leads the choosing of Judas's replacement
lifeEvents.description: Explains the need to replace Judas and oversees the casting of lots.

lifeEvents.title: Preaches the first sermon of the church at Pentecost
lifeEvents.description: Explains the tongues of fire and calls the crowd to repent and be baptized.

lifeEvents.title: Heals a man lame from birth
lifeEvents.description: Heals a beggar at the temple gate in the name of Jesus.

lifeEvents.title: Learns God shows no favoritism between nations
lifeEvents.description: Has a vision reinterpreting clean and unclean, then baptizes a Gentile household.

lifeEvents.title: Refuses, plague after plague
lifeEvents.description: Each time a plague lifts, his heart hardens and he refuses to let Israel go.

lifeEvents.title: Finally lets Israel go
lifeEvents.description: After his own son dies in the tenth plague, he tells Moses and Aaron to take Israel and leave.

lifeEvents.title: Pursues Israel to the sea
lifeEvents.description: He changes his mind and chases Israel with his army, which the sea then destroys.

lifeEvents.title: Finds the basket in the reeds
lifeEvents.description: Bathing at the river, she sees the basket, sends a servant for it, and hears the baby crying.

lifeEvents.title: Adopts him as her son
lifeEvents.description: She names him Moses - because I drew him out of the water.

lifeEvents.title: Is called directly by Jesus and brings Nathanael
lifeEvents.description: Follows Jesus's simple "follow me," then finds his friend Nathanael.

lifeEvents.title: Is saved from suicide and comes to faith
lifeEvents.description: Asks Paul what he must do to be saved and is baptized with his household.

lifeEvents.title: Releases Barabbas and condemns Jesus
lifeEvents.description: Washes his hands of the decision while giving in to the crowd's demand.

lifeEvents.title: Tests Solomon with hard questions
lifeEvents.description: Travels from Sheba to see if his reported wisdom is real.

lifeEvents.title: Met at the well
lifeEvents.description: Jacob rolls the stone away for her flock and weeps aloud when he kisses her.

lifeEvents.title: Barren while her sister bears sons
lifeEvents.description: Loved but childless, she envies Leah and pleads with Jacob for children.

lifeEvents.title: God remembers her
lifeEvents.description: She bears Joseph, and asks for one more son.

lifeEvents.title: Dies giving birth to Benjamin
lifeEvents.description: She names him son of my sorrow with her last breath; Jacob renames him son of my right hand.

lifeEvents.title: Hides the Israelite spies
lifeEvents.description: She hides them on her roof, believing Yahweh has already given Israel the land, and asks only that her family be spared.

lifeEvents.title: Spared when Jericho falls
lifeEvents.description: She and her family are the only ones in the city who survive.

lifeEvents.title: Waters ten camels for a stranger
lifeEvents.description: Her kindness is the sign Abraham's servant had prayed for.

lifeEvents.title: Agrees to go
lifeEvents.description: Asked whether she will leave with the man, she says simply: I will go.

lifeEvents.title: Told two nations are in her womb
lifeEvents.description: The children struggle inside her; she is told the elder will serve the younger.

lifeEvents.title: Engineers Jacob's blessing
lifeEvents.description: She overhears Isaac's plan and dresses Jacob to take his brother's blessing.

lifeEvents.title: Rejects the elders' counsel
lifeEvents.description: Chooses harshness over his father's more moderate advisers, and loses ten tribes on the spot.

lifeEvents.title: Walks away sad rather than sell his possessions
lifeEvents.description: Cannot bring himself to give up his wealth to follow Jesus.

lifeEvents.title: Marries into Naomi's family, then is widowed
lifeEvents.description: She marries one of Naomi's sons; ten years later he is dead along with his father and brother.

lifeEvents.title: Refuses to leave Naomi
lifeEvents.description: "Where you go, I will go... your people will be my people, and your God my God."

lifeEvents.title: Gleans in Boaz's field
lifeEvents.description: She asks to gather leftover grain, and happens into the field of a man who already knows what she has done for Naomi.

lifeEvents.title: Asks Boaz for redemption
lifeEvents.description: At the threshing floor at night, she asks him to spread his garment over her as a near kinsman.

lifeEvents.title: Redeemed and married by Boaz
lifeEvents.description: He takes her as his wife at the town gate, before the elders of the city.

lifeEvents.title: Bears a son, Obed
lifeEvents.description: Her son becomes the grandfather of Jesse, the father of David.

lifeEvents.title: Meets Jesus at Jacob's well and believes
lifeEvents.description: Is offered living water and recognizes Jesus as the Messiah.

lifeEvents.title: Born a Nazirite
lifeEvents.description: An angel tells his once-childless mother he will begin to deliver Israel.

lifeEvents.title: Falls in love with Delilah
lifeEvents.description: She is paid to discover the secret of his strength.

lifeEvents.title: Betrayed and shorn
lifeEvents.description: Worn down, he finally tells her the truth, and loses his strength while he sleeps.

lifeEvents.title: Pulls down the temple
lifeEvents.description: Blinded and mocked, he prays for strength one last time and brings the building down on everyone in it.

lifeEvents.title: Given to Eli as a small child
lifeEvents.description: His mother Hannah brings him to serve at the tabernacle for life.

lifeEvents.title: Hears Yahweh call his name
lifeEvents.description: He answers, "Speak, for your servant hears."

lifeEvents.title: Anoints Saul as king
lifeEvents.description: He pours oil on Saul's head in private, then presents him to the people.

lifeEvents.title: Tells Saul he is rejected as king
lifeEvents.description: "To obey is better than sacrifice."

lifeEvents.title: Anoints David
lifeEvents.description: He anoints the youngest of Jesse's sons in the middle of his brothers.

lifeEvents.title: Appears to Saul after death
lifeEvents.description: Brought up by a medium, his spirit tells Saul he will die the next day.

lifeEvents.title: Mocks and conspires against the wall-builders
lifeEvents.description: Ridicules the rebuilding effort and conspires with allies to attack Jerusalem.

lifeEvents.title: Tries to lure Nehemiah into a trap
lifeEvents.description: Repeatedly invites Nehemiah to a meeting meant to harm him, then hires a false prophet against him.

lifeEvents.title: Leaves Haran with Abram
lifeEvents.description: She goes with him to a land neither of them has seen.

lifeEvents.title: Gives Hagar to Abram
lifeEvents.description: Childless and out of patience, she tries to build a family another way.

lifeEvents.title: Laughs at the tent door
lifeEvents.description: Told she will have a son within the year, she laughs — and is asked whether anything is too hard for Yahweh.

lifeEvents.title: Bears Isaac at ninety
lifeEvents.description: God has made laughter for her, and everyone who hears will laugh with her.

lifeEvents.title: Dies at Kiriath Arba
lifeEvents.description: Abraham comes to mourn for her and to weep for her.

lifeEvents.title: Chosen as Israel's first king
lifeEvents.description: From the smallest family in the smallest tribe, anointed and then acclaimed by all the people.

lifeEvents.title: Rejected as king
lifeEvents.description: Two acts of disobedience cost him the dynasty God would otherwise have established.

lifeEvents.title: Hunts David for years
lifeEvents.description: Jealous and increasingly desperate, he pursues the man he knows will replace him.

lifeEvents.title: Consults a medium at Endor
lifeEvents.description: With God silent, he breaks his own law banning mediums to ask one for help.

lifeEvents.title: Dies on Mount Gilboa
lifeEvents.description: Badly wounded and refusing capture, he falls on his own sword.

lifeEvents.title: His army struck down outside Jerusalem
lifeEvents.description: 185,000 dead in a night; he withdraws to Nineveh.

lifeEvents.title: Joins Daniel's food test
lifeEvents.description: Is renamed and trained for the king's service alongside Daniel.

lifeEvents.title: Refuses to bow and walks out of the furnace unharmed
lifeEvents.description: Refuses to worship Nebuchadnezzar's image and survives the furnace.

lifeEvents.title: Given a son, and gets him back from death
lifeEvents.description: Builds Elisha a room, is promised a child, and later rides to fetch the prophet when the boy dies.

lifeEvents.title: Sings hymns with Paul in a Philippian jail
lifeEvents.description: Is imprisoned alongside Paul and freed by the same earthquake.

lifeEvents.title: Is compelled to carry Jesus's cross
lifeEvents.description: Is pulled from the crowd by soldiers to carry the cross to Golgotha.

lifeEvents.title: Commands the army oppressing Israel
lifeEvents.description: For twenty years his nine hundred iron chariots keep Israel under Canaanite rule.

lifeEvents.title: Killed in his sleep by Jael
lifeEvents.description: He flees to what he thinks is a safe tent, and never wakes up.

lifeEvents.title: Becomes king
lifeEvents.description: Anointed by Zadok the priest while Adonijah is still trying to claim the throne.

lifeEvents.title: Asks for wisdom instead of riches
lifeEvents.description: Given a free choice by God, asks for an understanding heart to govern well.

lifeEvents.title: Judges between two mothers
lifeEvents.description: Exposes the real mother by ordering the child divided in two.

lifeEvents.title: Builds and dedicates the temple
lifeEvents.description: God's glory fills the finished temple as a cloud.

lifeEvents.title: Receives the queen of Sheba
lifeEvents.description: Answers all her hard questions; she says not half of his fame had been told her.

lifeEvents.title: His heart turns after other gods
lifeEvents.description: His many foreign wives draw him into idolatry in his old age; God tells him the kingdom will be torn away.

lifeEvents.title: Is stoned to death, forgiving his killers
lifeEvents.description: Sees a vision of Jesus and dies praying for his executioners.

lifeEvents.title: Raped by Amnon
lifeEvents.description: Her half-brother forces her, then throws her out and hates her afterward.

lifeEvents.title: Urges the disciples to go with Jesus even if it means dying
lifeEvents.description: Says "let's go also, that we may die with him" when Jesus heads toward danger at Bethany.

lifeEvents.title: Doubts the resurrection, then confesses Jesus as Lord and God
lifeEvents.description: Refuses to believe without touching Jesus's wounds, then does exactly that.

lifeEvents.title: Sent to die in battle
lifeEvents.description: Refuses to go home to his wife while his fellow soldiers are camped in the field, so David has Joab place him where the fighting is fiercest.

lifeEvents.title: Prospers while he seeks God
lifeEvents.description: As long as he sought Yahweh, God made him prosper, and his fame spread far.

lifeEvents.title: Struck with leprosy for his pride
lifeEvents.description: Enters the temple to burn incense, rages at the priests who stop him, and is a leper from that hour.

lifeEvents.title: Refuses the king's summons and loses her crown
lifeEvents.description: Refuses to be displayed before the king's feast and is deposed by irrevocable decree.

lifeEvents.title: Her flour and oil never run out
lifeEvents.description: Shares her last meal with Elijah first, and her jar never empties through the famine; later her son is revived after dying.

lifeEvents.title: Gives half his wealth to the poor and repays those he cheated
lifeEvents.description: Responds to Jesus's visit by making sweeping restitution on the spot.

lifeEvents.title: Is visited by Gabriel and struck mute for doubting
lifeEvents.description: Is told his wife will bear a son and loses his speech until the birth.

lifeEvents.title: Regains his speech and prophesies over John
lifeEvents.description: Names his son John as instructed and prophesies over his future.

lifeEvents.title: Rebukes Joash, and is killed for it
lifeEvents.description: "Because you have forsaken Yahweh, he has also forsaken you." He is stoned in the temple court; his last words: "May Yahweh see, and avenge."

lifeEvents.title: Encourages the rebuilding with a series of visions
lifeEvents.description: Supports Zerubbabel with visions reminding the exiles the work will finish by God's Spirit, not their own strength.

lifeEvents.title: The last king of Judah, blinded and exiled
lifeEvents.description: Sees his sons killed, then is blinded and taken to Babylon in chains.

lifeEvents.title: Leads the first return and lays the temple's foundation
lifeEvents.description: Leads the first wave of exiles home from Babylon and, with Jeshua, rebuilds the altar before the temple's foundation is laid.

lifeEvents.title: Finishes and dedicates the rebuilt temple
lifeEvents.description: Resumes and completes the temple's construction after Darius confirms Cyrus's decree.

lifeEvents.title: Met at a well in Midian
lifeEvents.description: Moses defends her and her sisters from shepherds driving them off, and waters their flock.

lifeEvents.title: Given to Moses in marriage
lifeEvents.description: Her father gives her to Moses, content that he should dwell with them.

lifeEvents.title: Bears a son, Gershom
lifeEvents.description: Moses names him Gershom - for he said, I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.
